title: Sad Turned Into Glad
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people far away from home
Were sad for oh so long;
But Jeremiah brought good news:
"You'll all come home with song!"

[Chorus]
He turns my sad to glad again,
My tears to singing too;
Like gardens drinking in the rain,
He makes me green and new.

[Verse 2]
"You'll sing upon the hill," He said,
"Where My own house will stand;
Like gardens that are watered well,
You'll bloom across the land."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The girls will dance, the young and old
Will clap and laugh and sing;
"I'll turn your mourning into joy,"
He said, "and gladness bring."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When Willow's brother dropped his cone
And all his face went sad,
She sat right down and shared her spoon,
Till both of them were glad.

[Chorus]
mood: Dancing music, kept small. A light skipping strum in two, like a tambourine shaken softly by a girl coming down a hill path, the step of people walking home. Soft ukulele strum carrying the skip, an upright bass plucking the first beat of each bar, nothing else. It starts a little grey and quiet in the first verse and brightens one shade each verse, until the last chorus is a sunny afternoon on a curb with two spoons.
